parsed.explanation: Rated as a division under the parent national regime (rule 12). The parent regime carries documented traveller-facing exposure: passport sex-marker restrictions, entry refusal and a fraud-ground lifetime-ineligibility route, documented abuse in immigration and federal custody, and official hostility framed around 'radically pro-transgender' groups. The division adds operating protections: public-accommodation and hate-crime coverage since 2018–2020, an enforced civil-rights ruling (July 2026), and abolition of the gender-panic defence. These offset the parent exposure only partly. Its own restrictions (minor care, sports ban, birth-certificate surgery rule) are largely resident-facing or stayed. No state facilities ban is documented for visitors. The 72-incident count has no denominator and the 'least safe' characterisation is attributed, so both get little weight. Net: at or slightly above the parent band, in the elevated-risk range.
